# CurveEditor

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCurveEditor` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCurveEditor.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCurveEditor.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasCurveEditor.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A tone / mapping curve (Curves)

## Overview

An optional histogram of the image being edited is drawn behind the curve — SetHistogram() takes the raw bin counts and the element scales them.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCurveEditor> CreateCurveEditor( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCurveEditor(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasCurveEditor(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasCurveEditor(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onCurveChanged` | `std::function<void(const ToneCurveSet&)> onCurveChanged` | Fired for every change while editing (live preview), including each step of a drag. |
| `onEditFinished` | `std::function<void(const ToneCurveSet&)> onEditFinished` | Fired once when a drag or a point add/remove finishes — the moment to commit an expensive re-render. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int)> onSelectionChanged` | Fired when the selected point changes (index, or -1 when cleared). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
